blocks.text: ILOILO CITY — Hua Siong College of Iloilo (HSCI) has cancelled classes at all levels at its main campus on Iznart Street on Thursday after what school officials described as a “reported security concern.” The precautionary suspension comes amid heightened concerns over campus security following recent deadly school shootings in Mindanao and Tacloban City.
